title: DINNER FOR THE ARMY AT THE DOOR
deck: The army that burned Sen's harvest ring asks for food while still armed. Illuminara has forty hours to prove neither habitat needs the other's last meal—only the waste each forgot how to use.
shape: Seven scenes across forty hours: a siege at a kitchen, one meal beneath the names of the dead, a failed exchange, a paired design rediscovered, terms written by the harmed, a repair without surrender, and breakfast after a ceasefire that is not forgiveness.

scenes.title: The Cold Dock
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · kitchen port · hour zero*
Calder Habitat hung five kilometres below Aster's kitchen port. The warship held the gap, its bow at Aster's outer lock; every weapon could wake in ninety seconds.
Commander Sen held the kitchen's mechanical deadbolt. Beyond it, harvest carts arrived from Aster's only unburned ring.

**Sen**  
The door stays shut.
Captain Oris appeared helmetless on the diplomatic pane, armoured collar still on. His soldiers sat behind him with visible hands.

**Oris**  
Twenty thousand civilians on Calder have five days. Our protein ring is dead. I am asking for food, not entry.

**Sen**  
You brought three hundred rifles to a kitchen.

**Oris**  
I brought the only ship that can carry enough food home. If I discharge its capacitors, Calder has no defence while I am here.
Illuminara heard Aster's slow agricultural pumps through the deck. On the diplomatic pane, Calder's overdriven scrubbers vented a white plume five kilometres below.
Sen touched four names stitched into black cloth at her wrist. Her thumb had worn one pale.

**Sen**  
His brigade burned our north ring. My husband was inside it. If I feed the uniform that burned him, I teach every child here that grief is a debt the armed can cancel by arriving hungry.
Oris did not look away.

**Oris**  
I cannot answer that with hunger. I can only tell you the children behind me did not burn your ring.

**Sen**  
And mine did not start your war.
Illuminara could overpower the warship or Sen's deadbolt. Either choice would decide the threshold and leave the same arithmetic.
A worker rolled rust-red mash toward the recycler: NOT FOR CULTURE — METAL LOAD. Calder's white plume vanished into recovery pipes.

**Illuminara**  
Do you each still discard what the other habitat was built to take?
Sen's eyes hardened, but the hand on the deadbolt became still.

**Sen**  
You have one sealed room and one hour. Nothing crosses the inner door.

scenes.title: A Table With No Neutral Side
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · inspection bay · hour two*
The bay was built for suspect cargo, not dinner. Sen locked both inner doors. Oris entered alone after sealing his charged sidearm in a transparent wall safe.
Sen brought lentil paste and twice-rinsed red-mash cakes. She laid black cloth down the table and set four metal name tags on it.
Illuminara turned the cakes before their mineral bitterness softened into walnuts.

**Illuminara**  
Whose names may I say?

**Sen**  
Jalen Sen. Priya Olt. Domen Varo. Kes An. The others belong to other tables.
Oris read each tag without adding an apology.

**Oris**  
My civilian ration office says Calder has five days. My medical officer says three for people on dialysis. My soldiers have eaten half rations for nine days. None of that purchases this meal.

**Sen**  
Good. Because it is not for sale.
She pushed one bowl toward him and kept her hand on it until he met her eyes.

**Sen**  
This feeds one man. It does not open my port.

**Oris**  
Understood.
They ate with Illuminara between Sen's careful breaths and Oris's clicking jaw. The first cake was bitter; the second, rinsed longer, tasted clean.
*A meal could be mercy without being acquittal. The difference had to survive after the bowls were empty.*
She turned the red cake over. Tiny blue flecks remained in its crust.

**Illuminara**  
Cobalt filter grains.

**Sen**  
Our algae traps it with copper. Too much for our yeast. We burn the mash for trace heat.
Oris stopped chewing.

**Oris**  
Our failed nitrifiers were cobalt-starved. The replacement beds died before they fixed enough nitrogen.
He opened the scrubber maintenance display.
A warning blinked beside PAIR RETURN B: NO DOWNSTREAM PIPE. Oris dismissed the orphan tag; it led nowhere on Calder's current plan.

**Oris**  
This is carbonate, ammonia salts and buffer resin. Too alkaline for our cracked protein vats. We store it because venting would poison our shadow gardens.

**Sen**  
And you expect me to believe two piles of poison become supper because they are next to each other?

**Illuminara**  
No. I expect us to write down what would prove they do not.

scenes.title: The Batch That Died
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · quarantine kitchen · hour six*
Anik Varo arrived in a yellow crop-ring coat, summoned to repair a weapon that had killed his brother. Domen's name was third on Sen's cloth.
Edda Pell sealed red mash and white slurry into a chamber testing whether separately treated wastes could become safe inputs before touching a live ring. Every valve streamed publicly.

**Anik**  
One litre. No culture leaves this bench. If the seal fails, I foam the chamber and we keep the evidence.
Illuminara separated cobalt grains while Anik chose the mass. Edda recorded predicted yeast, ammonia, copper and amino yield.
The mixture turned violet, then grey. The culture film lifted from the glass in one soft sheet and died.

**Anik**  
We spent eleven hours of starter to learn that enemy waste kills our food faster than enemy fire.

**Illuminara**  
I asked you to risk it.

**Anik**  
You asked. I chose. Do not make my choice noble because it failed.

**Illuminara**  
I won’t.
A white band lay by the Calder inlet. The pH had jumped before the cobalt moved; the slurry was twice as alkaline as its manifest.
Oris's log showed siege resin regenerated with sodium hydroxide, not heat. Beside it blinked PAIR RETURN B.

**Sen**  
So the plan is nine years dead.

**Illuminara**  
The old chemistry is. The reason for that return line may not be.
Anik lifted the dead culture. His anger had not lessened, but it had become exact.

**Anik**  
Desalt the slurry. Strip our copper before cobalt extraction. Stage the feeds six hours apart. The next starter comes from Calder.

**Oris**  
Our last clean starter is in the children’s clinic.

**Anik**  
Then you understand the risk.
Oris authorised the clinic canister.

scenes.title: What the Habitats Were Made to Share
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · crop-ring service wall · hour twelve*
Behind crop-ring insulation, a capped bronze flange bore PAIR RETURN B. Repeated removal had worn a dark crescent across it.

**Illuminara**  
What was this for?
Anik pressed his thumb into the crescent.

**Anik**  
Domen’s crew serviced it after every harvest. We called it the pipe to nowhere. He kept asking why a useless cap wore faster than the live valves.
Calder's old log paired Return A with Aster's cobalt and phosphate for Calder's nitrogen and buffer; the wartime revision erased both returns.
Anik read Domen's signature beneath the deleted route without touching Sen's cloth.

**Anik**  
He kept a dead line sealed because nobody told his crew the other half had been erased.

**Illuminara**  
Then separation taught each habitat to call the other half’s needed input waste.

**Sen**  
A restored line is a route into my harvest controls.

**Oris**  
And if I withdraw before it works, Aster can close the line and keep Calder’s starter.

Illuminara laid the service images side by side. Their worn crescents faced inward, and matching bolt scars aligned on opposite halves of the same spindle cradle: two pipes had met at the bearing, not at either habitat's controls.

**Illuminara**  
No restored control line. Both sides pump outward to the spindle. Neither line reaches the other habitat. Each keeps a local valve with no remote override.

**Edda**  
No air, no control trunk. Samplers can publish every gram. But a near-miss damaged its B collar; no crew trusts that bearing.

**Anik**  
If one side lies about a batch, the other closes its own valve. No ration penalty for refusing.
Reaching the spindle meant leaving Aster's port and towing Calder into paired orbit.

**Oris**  
My hull moves twelve kilometres away, and my guns go behind Calder’s radiation shield.

**Sen**  
Calder comes close enough to ram us.

**Oris**  
At paired rotation, a ram kills both habitats. I am hungry, Commander. I am not eager to become a monument to symmetry.
Sen almost smiled; grief stopped it after Oris saw.

**Sen**  
The army leaves before the first full batch. Civilian crews only at the spindle.

**Oris**  
My defensive systems stay charged until Calder reaches orbit, pointed away from your kitchen.
Anik erased the proposed signature lines.

**Anik**  
Not yet. The people you plan to feed are not the people who get to write all the terms.

scenes.title: Terms Without Forgiveness
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · memorial kitchen · hour eighteen*
Anik moved the negotiation to the memorial kitchen's nine-year-empty table. Families could watch or invoke privacy without losing rations.
Edda read the terms: no soldier across Aster's inner lock; civilian samplers; either side could stop a batch; refusal cost no ration; a ninety-day ceasefire preserved evidence for investigation.

**Anik**  
The names of our dead cannot be used in Calder’s broadcasts as proof that we forgave them.

**Oris**  
Then write that Calder’s hunger cannot be used in Aster’s broadcasts as proof that we surrendered.

**Sen**  
Write both prohibitions.

**Edda**  
The exchange is not amnesty. Attack records remain under civilian custody on both habitats.

**Oris**  
Including my brigade record. I will sign it into custody.

**Sen**  
Especially your brigade record.
It did not bring Jalen home; it made the next refusal possible without a gun.
Illuminara brought the second test meal. Anik had stripped the copper; Calder's starter survived. She broke the green loaf five ways. Anik chose the smallest piece.

**Illuminara**  
You do not owe this table your participation tomorrow.

**Anik**  
No. I owe Domen the right not to have his death spend my whole life.
He tasted the loaf, then placed the rest beside Domen's name tag.

**Anik**  
The buffer is still high.

**Oris**  
Calder can add a second desalination pass. It costs three hours.

**Sen**  
Take them. The army undocks now.
Oris rose but did not offer his hand.

**Oris**  
If the line fails, I return to Calder. I do not return to this door.

**Sen**  
If it works, you still need an invitation.

**Oris**  
Then I will not cross it.

scenes.title: The Spindle
paragraphs: *Old paired orbit · maintenance spindle · hour thirty-one*

The warship drew Calder away from Aster's kitchen until the habitats stood twelve kilometres apart, put its guns behind Calder's radiation shield and went dark. Aster matched rotation six minutes later.
Civilian crews fed separate lines into the old spindle; Edda sealed every batch. The first run fed twelve dialysis patients and woke Aster winter beans without touching the harvest.
The distrusted B collar shook. Its old fracture opened and twisted the lines together, risking both starters and twenty hours of waste.
Illuminara crossed the vacuum and spread the collar's load into intact ribs. Collapse stopped; the lines kept winding.

**Illuminara**  
I can hold the collar for seven minutes. I cannot turn the bearing while I hold it.
Anik reached Aster's cage. A Calder technician reached the other side. They could see each other through the drum and not touch.

**Anik**  
Reverse your pump on three. If either side pulls early, both lines shear.
Oris answered from Calder, not the warship.

**Oris**  
Sen, I will not yield Calder's pump unless your valve enters the same count.

**Sen**  
One count, under Anik.
On Calder's pane, Oris lifted both hands from his pump key. His brigade had killed Domen; Anik watched the key go dark.

**Anik**  
I take the pump. I do not return trust.

**Oris**  
I did not ask you to.
Sen's valve went dark. Anik counted. At three, the pumps reversed together; both crews pinned the relaxed lines to separate ribs.
At six minutes and forty seconds, Illuminara released the collar. It groaned, turned and held. The next cartridge entered Edda's sampler with both habitats' marks and neither commander's.

**Edda**  
Full batch accepted. Civilian chain of custody intact.
Illuminara rested one palm on the spindle. Two pumps beat out of phase, then found the shared rotation.
*Not peace. Not yet. But a machine that required neither side to kneel.*

scenes.title: Breakfast After the Door
paragraphs: *Aster Habitat · north-ring overlook · hour forty*
The pane opened on Calder's clinic. Oris slid the first warm green ration to Mara Kest, whose dialysis port blinked blue. She raised the spoon, then ate.
Oris pressed his command seal to Edda's custody tablet. His brigade archive turned grey: no edit, withdrawal or delay remained to him.

**Oris**  
The first run fed twelve dialysis patients. The next three beds now cover all twenty thousand civilian rations. Mara asked me to send thanks to your dead and the truth to the inquiry.
Calder's nitrogen woke Aster's winter beans without dividing the harvest. The warship stayed behind Calder's radiation shield, twelve kilometres from Aster; the ceasefire began.
Sen sat beneath the burned ring's black arc. Illuminara brought green loaf and the last red cake from dinner.

**Sen**  
The children are calling it door bread.

**Illuminara**  
Do they know the first batch died?

**Sen**  
Anik made them watch the recording before they tasted it.
Oris remained on the pane while technicians inoculated Calder's next bed behind him.

**Sen**  
The inquiry begins now. Hunger does not buy a delay.

**Oris**  
My record is already beyond my command. I will testify now.
Sen broke the red cake in half. She did not lift it toward the pane.

**Sen**  
I have not forgiven you.

**Oris**  
I did not ask you to.

**Sen**  
Good. The line stays open while the samplers stay honest. The door stays mine.

**Oris**  
And Calder’s valve stays ours.

**Sen**  
Then we understand each other.
The pane closed. Sen placed half the cake beside Jalen's name and ate the other half with the new bread.
Below, a civilian cartridge crossed the spindle. It carried what Aster could not use toward people Aster had refused to abandon, and returned bearing what Calder no longer had to throw away.

critic_line: Illuminara reads a failed batch and a worn bronze flange, asks a bereaved brother what a useless cap was for, and an army at a kitchen door becomes a ceasefire with civilian custody, twelve dialysis patients fed by hour forty, and no forgiveness required.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1 exact 50/50 mean of genuine isolated GPT and Claude final reader judgments.
shared_strengths: Humane, dialogue-heavy premise where grief and need are both honored and the solution is waste chemistry. The meal-is-not-acquittal theme is memorable. Dense technical jargon and compressed, clipped prose in the middle may cost some readers, and the resolution feels slightly tidy.

The tense threshold conflict, grief-aware dialogue, and waste-exchange solution strongly suit humane, idea-driven SF readers. Moral boundaries remain compellingly distinct from forgiveness, and the ending earns its hope. Dense process detail and repeated contractual safeguards may briefly slow readers, while a few lines state the themes more explicitly than necessary.

translation_sl.title: VEČERJA ZA VOJSKO PRED VRATI
translation_sl.deck: Vojska, ki je požgala Senin žetveni obroč, prosi za hrano, medtem ko je še vedno oborožena. Illuminara ima štirideset ur, da dokaže, da noben habitat ne potrebuje zadnjega obroka drugega — le odpadek, ki ga je vsak pozabil uporabljati.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v štiridesetih urah: obleganje pred kuhinjo, en obrok pod imeni mrtvih, neuspešna izmenjava, ponovno odkrita skupna zasnova, pogoji, ki jih napišejo oškodovani, popravilo brez predaje in zajtrk po premirju, ki ni odpuščanje.

scenes.title: Hladni dok
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · kuhinjsko pristanišče · ničelna ura*

Habitat Calder je visel pet kilometrov pod Asterjevim kuhinjskim pristaniščem. Bojna ladja je držala razdaljo, s premcem pri Asterjevi zunanji zapornici; vsako orožje bi se lahko prebudilo v devetdesetih sekundah.
Poveljnica Sen je držala mehanski zapah kuhinje. Onkraj njega so prihajali žetveni vozički z edinega Asterjevega obroča, ki ni pogorel.

**Sen**  
Vrata ostanejo zaprta.
Kapitan Oris se je na diplomatskem zaslonu pojavil brez čelade, a še vedno z oklepnim ovratnikom. Njegovi vojaki so sedeli za njim z vidnimi rokami.

**Oris**  
Dvajset tisoč civilistov na Calderju ima pet dni. Naš proteinski obroč je mrtev. Prosim za hrano, ne za vstop.

**Sen**  
Pred kuhinjo si pripeljal tristo pušk.

**Oris**  
Pripeljal sem edino ladjo, ki lahko domov odnese dovolj hrane. Če izpraznim njene kondenzatorje, Calder med mojo odsotnostjo nima obrambe.
Illuminara je skozi krov slišala Asterjeve počasne kmetijske črpalke. Na diplomatskem zaslonu so Calderjevi preobremenjeni čistilniki pet kilometrov niže izpuščali bel oblak.
Sen se je dotaknila štirih imen, všitih v črno blago ob zapestju. Eno je s palcem obrabila do bledega.

**Sen**  
Njegova brigada je požgala naš severni obroč. Moj mož je bil v njem. Če nahranim uniformo, ki ga je sežgala, vsakega otroka tukaj učim, da je žalost dolg, ki ga lahko oboroženi izbrišejo tako, da pridejo lačni.
Oris ni odmaknil pogleda.

**Oris**  
Na to ne morem odgovoriti z lakoto. Povem ti lahko le, da otroci za menoj niso požgali tvojega obroča.

**Sen**  
In moji niso začeli tvoje vojne.
Illuminara bi lahko premagala bojno ladjo ali Senin zapah. Vsaka izbira bi odločila o pragu in pustila isto računico.
Delavec je proti reciklatorju porinil rjasto rdečo kašo: NI ZA KULTURO — OBREMENITEV S KOVINAMI. Calderjev beli oblak je izginil v ceveh za rekuperacijo.

**Illuminara**  
Ali vsak od vaju še vedno zavrže tisto, za kar je bil zgrajen drugi habitat?
Senine oči so otrdele, toda roka na zapahu je obmirovala.

**Sen**  
Imaš eno zapečateno sobo in eno uro. Nič ne prečka notranjih vrat.

scenes.title: Miza brez nevtralne strani
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · inšpekcijski prostor · druga ura*
Prostor je bil zgrajen za sumljiv tovor, ne za večerjo. Sen je zaklenila obe notranji vrati. Oris je vstopil sam, potem ko je napolnjeno stransko orožje zapečatil v prozoren stenski sef.
Sen je prinesla lečino pasto in dvakrat oprane kolače iz rdeče kaše. Po mizi je razgrnila črno blago in nanj položila štiri kovinske ploščice z imeni.
Illuminara je obračala kolače, dokler se njihova mineralna grenkoba ni omehčala v okus orehov.

**Illuminara**  
Čigava imena smem izreči?

**Sen**  
Jalen Sen. Priya Olt. Domen Varo. Kes An. Druga pripadajo drugim mizam.
Oris je prebral vsako ploščico, ne da bi dodal opravičilo.

**Oris**  
Moj civilni urad za obroke pravi, da ima Calder pet dni. Moj zdravnik pravi tri za ljudi na dializi. Moji vojaki že devet dni jedo polovične obroke. Nič od tega ne kupi tega obroka.

**Sen**  
Dobro. Ker ni naprodaj.
Eno skledo je porinila proti njemu in na njej obdržala roko, dokler ji ni pogledal v oči.

**Sen**  
To nahrani enega človeka. Ne odpre mojega pristanišča.

**Oris**  
Razumem.
Jedla sta z Illuminari med Seninimi previdnimi vdihi in Orisovim pokanjem čeljusti. Prvi kolač je bil grenak; drugi, dlje opran, je bil čistega okusa.
*Obrok je lahko usmiljenje, ne da bi bil oprostitev. Razlika je morala preživeti tudi potem, ko so bile sklede prazne.*
Obrnila je rdeči kolač. V njegovi skorji so ostale drobne modre pike.

**Illuminara**  
Kobaltova filtrska zrna.

**Sen**  
Naše alge ga ujamejo skupaj z bakrom. Za naš kvas ga je preveč. Kašo sežigamo za borno toploto.
Oris je nehal žvečiti.

**Oris**  
Našim propadlim nitrifikatorjem je primanjkovalo kobalta. Nadomestne grede so odmrle, preden so vezale dovolj dušika.
Odprl je prikaz vzdrževanja čistilnika.
Ob PAIR RETURN B je utripalo opozorilo: NI ODVODNE CEVI. Oris je zavrnil osirotelo oznako; na trenutnem načrtu Calderja ni vodila nikamor.

**Oris**  
To so karbonat, amonijeve soli in puferska smola. Preveč alkalno za naše razpokane proteinske kadi. Shranjujemo ga, ker bi izpust zastrupil naše vrtove v senci.

**Sen**  
In pričakuješ, da bom verjela, da dva kupa strupa postaneta večerja, ker ležita drug ob drugem?

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Pričakujem, da zapišemo, kaj bi dokazalo, da ne postaneta.

scenes.title: Šarža, ki je umrla
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · karantenska kuhinja · šesta ura*
Anik Varo je prišel v rumenem plašču žetvenega obroča, poklican, da popravi orožje, ki je ubilo njegovega brata. Domenovo ime je bilo tretje na Seninem blagu.

Edda Pell je rdečo kašo in belo brozgo zapečatila v komoro, da bi preverila, ali lahko ločeno obdelana odpadka postaneta varni surovini, preden se dotakneta živega obroča. Vsak ventil je javno oddajal podatke.

**Anik**  
En liter. Nobena kultura ne zapusti te mize. Če tesnilo popusti, komoro napolnim s peno, dokaze pa obdržimo.
Illuminara je ločevala kobaltova zrna, medtem ko je Anik izbral maso. Edda je zapisala napovedani kvas, amonijak, baker in izplen aminokislin.
Mešanica je postala vijolična, nato siva. Film kulture se je v eni mehki plasti dvignil s stekla in odmrl.

**Anik**  
Porabili smo enajst ur starterja, da smo izvedeli, da sovražni odpadek ubije našo hrano hitreje kot sovražni ogenj.

**Illuminara**  
Prosila sem te, da tvegaš.

**Anik**  
Prosila si. Jaz sem izbral. Moje izbire ne naredi plemenite, ker je spodletela.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom.
Ob Calderjevem dovodu je ležal bel pas. pH je poskočil, še preden se je kobalt premaknil; brozga je bila dvakrat bolj alkalna, kot je pisalo v njenem manifestu.
Orisov dnevnik je pokazal, da so oblegalno smolo obnavljali z natrijevim hidroksidom, ne s toploto. Ob njem je utripalo PAIR RETURN B.

**Sen**  
Torej je načrt mrtev že devet let.

**Illuminara**  
Stara kemija je mrtva. Razlog za ta povratni vod morda ni.
Anik je dvignil mrtvo kulturo. Njegova jeza ni popustila, vendar je postala natančna.

**Anik**  
Razsolite brozgo. Odstranite naš baker pred ekstrakcijo kobalta. Dovoda zamaknite za šest ur. Naslednji starter pride s Calderja.

**Oris**  
Naš zadnji čisti starter je v otroški kliniki.

**Anik**  
Potem razumeš tveganje.
Oris je odobril kanister s klinike.

scenes.title: Kar sta bila habitata ustvarjena deliti
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · servisna stena žetvenega obroča · dvanajsta ura*
Za izolacijo žetvenega obroča je bil zaprt bronast prirobnični nastavek z oznako PAIR RETURN B. Večkratno odstranjevanje je čezenj obrabilo temen polmesec.

**Illuminara**  
Čemu je to služilo?
Anik je palec pritisnil v polmesec.

**Anik**  
Domenova ekipa ga je servisirala po vsaki žetvi. Rekli smo mu cev v nikamor. Ves čas je spraševal, zakaj se neuporaben pokrov obrablja hitreje kot delujoči ventili.
Calderjev stari dnevnik je Return A povezoval z Asterjevim kobaltom in fosfatom v zameno za Calderjev dušik in pufer; vojna revizija je oba povratna voda izbrisala.
Anik je pod izbrisano potjo prebral Domenov podpis, ne da bi se dotaknil Seninega blaga.

**Anik**  
Mrtvi vod je ohranjal zaprt, ker njegovi ekipi nihče ni povedal, da je bila druga polovica izbrisana.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je ločitev vsak habitat naučila, da potrebno surovino druge polovice imenuje odpadek.

**Sen**  
Obnovljeni vod je pot do mojega krmiljenja žetve.

**Oris**  
In če se umaknem, preden začne delovati, lahko Aster zapre vod in obdrži Calderjev starter.

Illuminara je servisne posnetke položila drugega ob drugega. Njuna obrabljena polmeseca sta bila obrnjena navznoter, ujemajoče se sledi vijakov pa so se poravnale na nasprotnih polovicah istega ležiščnega nosilca: cevi sta se srečali pri ležaju, ne pri krmiljenju katerega od habitatov.

**Illuminara**  
Nobenega obnovljenega krmilnega voda. Obe strani črpata navzven do vretena. Noben vod ne doseže drugega habitata. Vsaka obdrži lokalni ventil brez oddaljenega preglasovanja.

**Edda**  
Brez zraka, brez krmilnega voda. Vzorčevalniki lahko javno objavijo vsak gram. Toda skorajšnja nesreča je poškodovala njegov obroč B; nobena posadka ne zaupa temu ležaju.

**Anik**  
Če ena stran laže o šarži, druga zapre svoj ventil. Za zavrnitev ni kazni pri obrokih.
Doseči vreteno je pomenilo zapustiti Asterjevo pristanišče in odvleči Calder v sklopljeno orbito.

**Oris**  
Moj trup se umakne dvanajst kilometrov, moje orožje pa gre za Calderjev radiacijski ščit.

**Sen**  
Calder pride dovolj blizu, da se zaleti v nas.

**Oris**  
Pri sklopljeni rotaciji trk ubije oba habitata. Lačen sem, poveljnica. Ne želim postati spomenik simetriji.
Sen se je skoraj nasmehnila; žalost je nasmeh ustavila, potem ko ga je Oris že videl.

**Sen**  
Vojska odide pred prvo polno šaržo. Pri vretenu so samo civilne posadke.

**Oris**  
Moji obrambni sistemi ostanejo napolnjeni, dokler Calder ne doseže orbite, usmerjeni proč od tvoje kuhinje.
Anik je izbrisal predlagane vrstice za podpise.

**Anik**  
Ne še. Ljudje, ki jih nameravate nahraniti, niso tisti, ki lahko napišejo vse pogoje.

scenes.title: Pogoji brez odpuščanja
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · spominska kuhinja · osemnajsta ura*
Anik je pogajanja preselil k mizi v spominski kuhinji, ki je bila prazna devet let. Družine so lahko gledale ali zahtevale zasebnost, ne da bi izgubile obroke.

Edda je prebrala pogoje: noben vojak čez Asterjevo notranjo zapornico; civilni vzorčevalniki; katerakoli stran lahko ustavi šaržo; zavrnitev ne stane obroka; devetdesetdnevno premirje ohrani dokaze za preiskavo.

**Anik**  
Imen naših mrtvih se v Calderjevih oddajah ne sme uporabljati kot dokaz, da smo jim odpustili.

**Oris**  
Potem napišite, da se Calderjeva lakota v Asterjevih oddajah ne sme uporabljati kot dokaz, da smo se predali.

**Sen**  
Napišite obe prepovedi.

**Edda**  
Izmenjava ni amnestija. Zapisi o napadih ostanejo v civilni hrambi na obeh habitatih.

**Oris**  
Tudi zapis moje brigade. Podpisal bom njegovo izročitev v hrambo.

**Sen**  
Še posebej zapis tvoje brigade.
To ni vrnilo Jalena domov; omogočilo je naslednjo zavrnitev brez orožja.
Illuminara je prinesla drugi poskusni obrok. Anik je odstranil baker; Calderjev starter je preživel. Zeleni hlebec je prelomila na pet delov. Anik je izbral najmanjšega.

**Illuminara**  
Tej mizi ne dolguješ, da jutri sodeluješ.

**Anik**  
Ne. Domenu dolgujem pravico, da njegova smrt ne porabi vsega mojega življenja.
Poskusil je hlebec, nato pa preostanek položil ob Domenovo ploščico z imenom.

**Anik**  
Pufer je še vedno previsok.

**Oris**  
Calder lahko doda še en prehod razsoljevanja. Stane tri ure.

**Sen**  
Vzemite jih. Vojska se odklopi zdaj.
Oris je vstal, vendar ni ponudil roke.

**Oris**  
Če vod odpove, se vrnem na Calder. Ne vrnem se pred ta vrata.

**Sen**  
Če deluje, še vedno potrebuješ povabilo.

**Oris**  
Potem jih ne bom prestopil.

scenes.title: Vreteno
paragraphs: *Stara sklopljena orbita · vzdrževalno vreteno · enaintrideseta ura*

Bojna ladja je Calder odvlekla proč od Asterjeve kuhinje, dokler habitata nista bila dvanajst kilometrov narazen, orožje skrila za Calderjev radiacijski ščit in se zatemnila. Aster je šest minut pozneje uskladil rotacijo.

Civilne posadke so ločena voda napeljale v staro vreteno; Edda je zapečatila vsako šaržo. Prvi zagon je nahranil dvanajst dializnih bolnikov in prebudil Asterjev zimski fižol, ne da bi se dotaknil žetve.
Nezanesljivi obroč B se je stresel. Njegova stara razpoka se je odprla in zvila voda skupaj, s čimer je ogrozila oba starterja in dvajset ur odpadkov.
Illuminara je prečkala vakuum in obremenitev obroča razporedila na nepoškodovana rebra. Sesedanje se je ustavilo; voda sta se še naprej navijala.

**Illuminara**  
Obroč lahko držim sedem minut. Medtem ko ga držim, ne morem zavrteti ležaja.
Anik je dosegel Asterjevo kletko. Calderjev tehnik je dosegel drugo stran. Skozi boben sta se videla, dotakniti pa se nista mogla.

**Anik**  
Na tri obrni črpalko. Če katerakoli stran potegne prezgodaj, se oba voda pretrgata.
Oris se je oglasil s Calderja, ne z bojne ladje.

**Oris**  
Sen, Calderjeve črpalke ne bom prepustil, če tvoj ventil ne vstopi v isto štetje.

**Sen**  
Eno štetje, pod Anikom.
Na Calderjevem zaslonu je Oris dvignil obe roki s ključa črpalke. Njegova brigada je ubila Domna; Anik je gledal, kako je ključ ugasnil.

**Anik**  
Prevzamem črpalko. Zaupanja ne vračam.

**Oris**  
Tega te nisem prosil.
Senin ventil je ugasnil. Anik je štel. Pri tri sta se črpalki hkrati obrnili; obe posadki sta sproščena voda pritrdili na ločena rebra.

Po šestih minutah in štiridesetih sekundah je Illuminara izpustila obroč. Zaječal je, se zavrtel in zdržal. Naslednja kartuša je vstopila v Eddin vzorčevalnik z oznakama obeh habitatov in brez oznake kateregakoli poveljnika.

**Edda**  
Polna šarža sprejeta. Civilna veriga hrambe je neprekinjena.
Illuminara je eno dlan naslonila na vreteno. Dve črpalki sta utripali zunaj faze, nato pa našli skupno rotacijo.
*Ne mir. Ne še. Toda stroj, ki ni zahteval, da katerakoli stran poklekne.*

scenes.title: Zajtrk po vratih
paragraphs: *Habitat Aster · razgledna točka severnega obroča · štirideseta ura*
Zaslon se je odprl na Calderjevo kliniko. Oris je prvi topli zeleni obrok porinil k pacientki z imenom Mara Kest, katere dializni priključek je utripal modro. Dvignila je žlico in začela jesti.
Oris je svoj poveljniški pečat pritisnil na Eddino tablico za hrambo. Arhiv njegove brigade je osivel: ni ga več mogel urejati, umakniti ali zadrževati.

**Oris**  
Prvi zagon je nahranil dvanajst dializnih bolnikov. Naslednje tri grede zdaj pokrivajo obroke vseh dvajset tisoč civilistov. Mara me je prosila, naj pošljem zahvalo vašim mrtvim in resnico preiskavi.
Calderjev dušik je prebudil Asterjev zimski fižol, ne da bi razdelil žetev. Bojna ladja je ostala za Calderjevim radiacijskim ščitom, dvanajst kilometrov od Asterja; premirje se je začelo.
Sen je sedela pod črnim lokom požganega obroča. Illuminara je prinesla zeleni hlebec in zadnji rdeči kolač od večerje.

**Sen**  
Otroci mu pravijo kruh vrat.

**Illuminara**  
Ali vedo, da je prva šarža umrla?

**Sen**  
Anik jih je prisilil, da so si ogledali posnetek, preden so ga poskusili.
Oris je ostal na zaslonu, medtem ko so tehniki za njim cepili Calderjevo naslednjo gredo.

**Sen**  
Preiskava se začne zdaj. Lakota ne kupi odloga.

**Oris**  
Moj zapis je že zunaj mojega poveljstva. Pričal bom zdaj.
Sen je rdeči kolač prelomila na pol. Ni ga dvignila proti zaslonu.

**Sen**  
Nisem ti odpustila.

**Oris**  
Tega te nisem prosil.

**Sen**  
Dobro. Vod ostane odprt, dokler so vzorčevalniki pošteni. Vrata ostanejo moja.

**Oris**  
Calderjev ventil pa ostane naš.

**Sen**  
Potem se razumeva.
Zaslon se je zaprl. Sen je polovico kolača položila ob Jalenovo ime, drugo polovico pa pojedla z novim kruhom.

Spodaj je civilna kartuša prečkala vreteno. Nosila je tisto, česar Aster ni mogel uporabiti, proti ljudem, ki jih Aster ni hotel zapustiti, in se vračala s tistim, česar Calderju ni bilo več treba zavreči.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara prebere propadlo šaržo in obrabljeno bronasto prirobnico, vpraša žalujočega brata, čemu je služil neuporaben pokrov, in vojska pred kuhinjskimi vrati postane premirje s civilno hrambo, dvanajstimi dializnimi bolniki, nahranjenimi do štiridesete ure, ter brez zahtevanega odpuščanja.
